language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for the user interface.

liveDashboard.title: Live Dashboard
liveDashboard.autoLiveDescription: Automatically switch to a camera's live view when activity is detected. Disabling this option causes static camera images on your dashboards to only update once per minute.
liveDashboard.autoLiveNote: This is a global setting but can be overridden on each camera in camera groups only.
liveDashboard.alertVideosDescription: By default, recent alerts on the Live dashboard play as small looping videos. Disable this option to only show a static image of recent alerts on this device/browser.

layouts.title: Stored Layouts
layouts.description: The layout of cameras in a camera group can be dragged/resized. The positions are stored in your browser's local storage.

streaming.title: Camera Group Streaming Settings
streaming.description: Streaming settings for each camera group are stored in your browser's local storage.
streaming.cleared: Cleared streaming settings for all camera groups.
streaming.clearError: Failed to clear camera groups streaming settings: {{error}}

recordings.title: Recordings Viewer
recordings.playbackRateDescription: Default playback rate for recordings playback.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.firstWeekdayDescription: The day that the weeks of the review calendar begin on.
